title: Builder Extended Rate Lock — Upfront Fee Credit, Refund and Forfeiture Table
content:
What becomes of a Builder Extended Rate Lock upfront fee when the lock funds or ends without funding is set term by term in the following table.

| Lock term | Fee credited to the buyer at funding | Fee refunded on a builder-delay cancellation | Percent of the fee refunded on a financing denial | Fee forfeited on withdrawal by the buyer | Percent of the fee refunded on rescission | Business days within which a refund is issued |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Day Standard Lock | Yes | Yes | 100% | Yes | 100% | 10 |
| 90-Day Lock | Yes | Yes | 100% | Yes | 100% | 10 |
| 120-Day Extended Lock | Yes | Yes | 50% | Yes | 100% | 10 |
| 180-Day Extended Lock | Yes | Yes | 50% | Yes | 100% | 10 |
| 270-Day Build Lock | Yes | Yes | 25% | Yes | 100% | 10 |
| 360-Day Build Lock | Yes | Yes | 25% | Yes | 100% | 10 |

## Column meanings

- **Fee credited at funding** — whether the upfront fee is credited to the buyer at funding.
- **Refunded on a builder-delay cancellation** — whether the upfront fee is refunded when the purchase agreement is cancelled for builder delay.
- **Financing denial percent** — the percent of the upfront fee refunded when the loan is denied and the purchase is cancelled for financing denial.
- **Forfeited on withdrawal** — whether the upfront fee is forfeited when the buyer withdraws the lock.
- **Rescission percent** — the percent of the upfront fee refunded when the purchase agreement is rescinded.
- **Refund business days** — the business days after a cancellation within which a refund of the upfront fee is issued.

## Points of reference

**Where do the terms differ?** Only in the financing denial column: 100% on the 60-Day Standard Lock and the 90-Day Lock, 50% on the 120-Day and 180-Day Extended Locks, and 25% on the 270-Day and 360-Day Build Locks.

**Is any term without a fee credit at funding?** No. Every term of the Builder Extended Rate Lock reads Yes in the funding column.
